title: The 12 Best Immersion Blenders Under $50
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for immersion blenders under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at immersion blenders under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart CSB-75BC Smart Stick Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 200W motor, single speed, Stainless steel blending shaft, heat-rated for hot soup, One-button blade eject for tool-free cleaning.
strengths: Handles all standard cooked soups and sauces reliably at 200W
One-button blade eject skips disassembly entirely, faster cleanup than twist-off competitors
Stainless shaft heat-rated for direct use in boiling soup
limitations: Single speed, no variable control for delicate finishing tasks
No included attachments (whisk, chopper, beaker)
features: Stainless steel blending shaft, heat-rated for hot soup
One-button blade eject for tool-free cleaning

products.name: KitchenAid KHB2351OB 3-Speed Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-speed control, Stainless steel blending shaft, dishwasher-safe, Bell guard locks shaft to motor to prevent wobble.
strengths: 3-speed control adds meaningful flexibility over the single-speed Cuisinart at a similar price
Dishwasher-safe shaft is a genuine cleanup convenience most budget models lack
KitchenAid build quality, no wobble at the shaft-to-motor connection
limitations: Not as powerful as premium models for thick or fibrous mixtures
No whisk or chopper attachment included
Plastic housing feels less premium than the All-Clad or Vitamix options
features: Bell guard locks shaft to motor to prevent wobble

products.name: Braun MQ505 Multiquick Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: EasyClick shaft attachment, no twisting to attach or remove, Splash Control bell guard, Soft-grip, contoured handle.
strengths: EasyClick one-button shaft release is faster and more convenient than twist-off designs
Splash Control bell guard measurably reduces hot-soup splashing versus standard guards
Softer, better-contoured grip than most competitors reduces hand fatigue on longer sessions
Braun engineering pedigree carries recognizable reliability
limitations: No included attachments beyond the base shaft
Fewer speed settings than the KitchenAid KHB2351's 3-speed dial
features: EasyClick shaft attachment, no twisting to attach or remove

products.name: Hamilton Beach 59765 2-Speed Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-speed control, Stainless steel blending shaft, Basic bell guard.
strengths: 2 speeds cover the basics without unnecessary complexity
Handles standard weekly soup and sauce tasks adequately
limitations: Motor is the weakest of the picks, rests are needed for anything denser than a standard tomato soup
No included attachments
Plastic body feels less durable than the Braun or KitchenAid

products.name: BELLA 10-Speed Immersion Blender with Attachments 14769
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-speed dial, Includes whisk, chopper, and beaker attachments, Stainless steel blending shaft.
strengths: 10-speed dial gives fine-grained control unusual at this price
Wall-mount bracket is a practical storage touch missing from most competitors
limitations: Motor output is roughly equivalent to the single-speed Cuisinart despite the 10-speed range
Chopper bowl is small, not a substitute for a dedicated food processor
Plastic body feels less durable than the Braun or KitchenAid
features: Includes whisk, chopper, and beaker attachments

products.name: Proctor Silex 59739 2-Speed Immersion Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-speed control, Stainless steel blending shaft, Basic bell guard.
strengths: Handles standard cooked soups without complaint
Simple two-button operation with no learning curve
limitations: Motor is the weakestfor thick or dense mixtures
No included attachments
Fewer ratings than the top picks, so long-term durability data is thinner

Oster brand recognition adds a reliability data point

No included attachments
Motor lacks headroom for thick or fibrous mixtures

products.name: Cuisinart CSB-175P1 Smart Stick Two-Speed Hand Blender

strengths: Adds a second speed over the entry-level CSB-75BC while keeping the same reliable blade eject mechanism
Stainless shaft heat-rated for direct hot soup use

No included attachments
Motor runs warm on dense mixtures after a few minutes, same as the base Smart Stick

products.name: Hamilton Beach 59762 2-Speed Hand Blender

Simple operation with no learning curve

Travel lid on the included jar doubles as an on-the-go container
Small footprint suits limited counter or cabinet space

Blade assembly requires more careful hand washing than a simple stick shaft
